budget: two capacities per available FA layer; fixed256steps/model; all valid held-out frames evaluated; no hyperparameter sweep
objective: dense-mass KL plus2x weighted hard-negative page ranking; importance mixes mean and max of six dense-head masses
split: existing CODE32K/128K plus new CODE128K train; all CODE200K and every TOOLS frame held out; no adjacent-position shuffle across split
acceptance: learned must beat best matched heuristic accuracy versus actual global physical page union, below1% output L2, before fusion
